text: [FOLLOW-UP to 102-F/106-S] Deferred in-repo hardening for Ship claim integrity: (1) extend shipment-reconcile pre-mode with a shipment-record-status classification (compare the shipment's own status vs its manifest tasks' statuses) as the long-term home for this integrity check; (2) optional true self-repair (auto re-claim/repair) beyond detect-and-report, honoring the skill's current 'no auto-repair' stance until deliberately lifted; (3) after 102-F ships, capture the two guard tokens (CLAIM_VERIFY_FAILED, SHIPMENT_STATE_INCONSISTENT) + the queued-with-active-work pattern as a compound learning. NOTE: the backlogit-internal active->queued transition guard remains EXTERNAL (route upstream to the backlogit project) - documented in docs/decisions/2026-07-30-ship-claim-integrity-preflight-spike.md; not re-stashed here.
